subject: OpenWorldEngine swallows a flag refusal with NO visible fallback
description: Separate defect from the BoxEngine fix shipped 2026-09-19. OpenWorldEngine.js:353-355 does console.warn + return null exactly as BoxEngine did, but its caller at :321-325 is 'if (flagText && conn._onFlagDelivered)' - so on refusal it renders NOTHING AT ALL, genuinely silent, no placeholder to swap. Affects the ~10 ow-*/ows-* boxes. Nancy required this be tracked separately rather than bundled into the BoxEngine message fix. Fix: surface the reason via the existing showNotification (OpenWorldEngine.js:581).
